0022600099.text: The Bucks, who are 0-1 and on a one-game losing streak, host the 0-1 Bulls in Milwaukee's second game of the season, and they sit 4th in the Central and 13th in the East. Chicago is 5th in the Central and 15th in the East, and Nic Claxton is out for the Bulls with a hamstring injury. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though the Bucks lost their most recent meeting 120-97 in Chicago on March 1, 2026.
